test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Since** Hamlet loved Ophelia, he should have trusted her more openly.
solution:
The correct answer is '**1**' i.e. 'Because'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The conjunction **"Because"** is used to indicate the reason or cause of something.
 
• In the given sentence, the clause "**Hamlet loved Ophelia**" provides a reason why he "**should have trusted her more openly**."
 
• Using "Because"</strong
